dialogues.speaker: Housein
dialogues.text: It takes courage to maintain a peaceful life too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you run into some trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Housein
dialogues.text: No, no. It was just a thought.

dialogues.speaker: Housein
dialogues.text: I used to be a sailor. I've seen every kind of storm you could imagine, and not even a shipwreck could get the better of me.

dialogues.speaker: Housein
dialogues.text: The way I see it, gales and tidal waves are nothing compared to always trying to keep steady in life.

dialogues.speaker: Housein
dialogues.text: I guess what I'm trying to say is, planting a seed is easy, but raising that little sapling into a mighty tree is where the real work lies...

dialogues.speaker: Housein
dialogues.text: But don't let my brother Hassan hear that, or he'll start lecturing me again for being ungrateful, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Housein
dialogues.text: You wouldn't think so if a Mahamata kept asking you to move the stall here and there until you found a place that "doesn't affect the image of the city"...

dialogues.speaker: Housein
dialogues.text: In that case, even the experience of surviving ten shipwrecks wouldn't help so much.
